sources.title: Inspect
sources.snippet: Composable building blocks—datasets, agents, tools, and scorers—that make evaluations easy to write and reuse. A collection of over 200 pre-built evaluations ready to run on any model. Extensive tooling, including a web-based Inspect View tool for monitoring and visualizing evaluations and a VS Code Extension that assists with authoring and debugging. Flexible support for tool calling ...
